svg.text: Prayers at the Foot of the Altar · LM-001A–LM-012A · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

UNRESOLVED: The approved record does not state whether the reverence made at the foot is a
profound bow of the body or a genuflection; it is depicted here as a profound bow.
UNRESOLVED: The approved record does not fix the moment at which the servers kneel. It settles
only that they are already kneeling by the priest's Confiteor, so the kneeling is placed at this
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
Sign of the cross and Introibo ad altare Dei
“In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti. Amen. Introibo ad altare
priest: standing · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · L on-breast / R signing

AC1: “Ad Deum qui laetificat juventutem meam.”

Indulgentiam. It does not state whether the servers also sign themselves at the opening 'In
nomine Patris', so they are drawn here with hands joined.

“Quia tu es, Deus, fortitudo mea: quare me repulisti, et quare tristis incedo,

“Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto.” (audible)
priest: standing · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC1: kneeling · plano-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · plano-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC1: “Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.”
AC2: “Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.”
VARIANT [seasonal] In Passiontide and at Requiem Masses this psalm doxology is omitted, and the
antiphon "Introibo ad altare Dei" of LM-005A follows the last verse of the psalm directly. This
is a departure from the baseline, not an alternative reading of it.
UNRESOLVED: The approved record does not state whether the priest bows his head at the psalm
doxology; no head bow is asserted here.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-NAME-01,

UNRESOLVED: As at the opening sign of the cross, the approved record does not state whether the
servers sign themselves at 'Adjutorium nostrum'; they are drawn here with hands joined.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
“Confiteor Deo omnipotenti, beatae Mariae semper Virgini, beato Michaeli
Archangelo, beato Joanni Baptistae, sanctis Apostolis Petro et Paulo, omnibus
Sanctis, et vobis, fratres, quia peccavi nimis cogitatione, verbo et opere.”
priest: standing · bow body-profound · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes downcast ·
AC1: kneeling · plano-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · plano-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
UNRESOLVED: The approved record fixes only the profound body bow for the priest's Confiteor. It
does not state whether the priest's own three breast strikes at 'mea culpa, mea culpa, mea
maxima culpa' are to be depicted, so no strike gesture is asserted in this scene.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
“Misereatur tui omnipotens Deus, et dimissis peccatis tuis, perducat te ad
priest: standing · bow body-profound · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes downcast ·
AC1: kneeling · bow head-slight · plano-epistle · faces inward-to-priest · eyes inward-to-priest
AC2: kneeling · bow head-slight · plano-gospel · faces inward-to-priest · eyes inward-to-priest
AC1: “Misereatur tui omnipotens Deus, et dimissis peccatis tuis, perducat te ad vitam aeternam.”
AC2: “Misereatur tui omnipotens Deus, et dimissis peccatis tuis, perducat te ad vitam aeternam.”
UNRESOLVED: The approved record does not state at which word the priest rises from the profound
bow of his Confiteor. It settles only that he stands upright at the Misereatur vestri, so the
rising is placed at his 'Amen' here.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
“Confiteor Deo omnipotenti, beatae Mariae semper Virgini, beato Michaeli
Archangelo, beato Joanni Baptistae, sanctis Apostolis Petro et Paulo, omnibus
priest: standing · plano-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC1: kneeling · bow head-slight · plano-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes downcast ·
AC2: kneeling · bow head-slight · plano-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes downcast ·
AC1: “Confiteor Deo omnipotenti, beatae Mariae semper Virgini, beato Michaeli Archangelo, beato
Joanni Baptistae, sanctis Apostolis Petro et Paulo, omnibus Sanctis.”
AC2: “Confiteor Deo omnipotenti, beatae Mariae semper Virgini, beato Michaeli Archangelo, beato
Joanni Baptistae, sanctis Apostolis Petro et Paulo, omnibus Sanctis.”
UNRESOLVED: The approved record says only that the servers' heads 'remain bowed' during their
own Confiteor. It does not fix a degree beyond the slight head bow of their response to the
priest's Confiteor, which is what is carried here.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
